section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1970
title: 21 ## Distribution of Suicides by Sex On an average, 59.6% of the persons who committed suicide were males. Assam (72.8%), Himachal Pradesh (76.9%), Manipur (89.5%), Nagaland (100.0%), Punjab (79.5%) recorded more than 70% of male involvement while the other States generally reflect the All-India pattern. The percentage of male involvement in almost all the Union Territories, excepting Chandigarh and Goa, Daman and Diu, was more than the average of all the Union Territories together. In the Cities
